fields.text: Reading guide page 8 of 10, the highest-risk page: the Writ_channel service, per-session buckets, the label-to-subject lookup, and session admission and close. Claim 2 (lines 1539-1553) is the one place a reviewer could reasonably say the shim makes a policy decision: a session is admitted only when the parent policy matches by label or label_prefix and names a nonzero subject. My reading is that this is the route-identity binding GB-007 requires, not a decision about any request; the page argues it and you decide. About 25 minutes.
Page 8: all four claims confirmed, including the label-to-subject admission rule as route-identity binding. Page 9 is posted as q15 (take, put, and the transport refusal).
